stem: Meera connects a cell, a lamp and a switch in a simple circuit in her classroom. The lamp is glowing. What does this tell us about the switch?

options.text: The switch is open, so the circuit is complete
The switch is closed, so the circuit is complete
The switch is open, so the circuit is broken
The switch is closed, so the circuit is broken

teacher.key_rationale: A lamp glows only when current flows, which requires a complete path; a closed switch completes the circuit, so B is correct.
